course_summary:
ISEN 613 | Engineering Data Analysis | Fall 2026
Instructor: Joseph Geunes | geunes@tamu.edu
Meets: TR 11:10AM-12:25PM | ZACH 266
Grading: Homework [30%], Midterm Exam [35%], Final Project [35%] — A: 90-100%, B: 80-89.9%, C: 70-79.9%, D: 60-69.9%, F: below 60%
Topics: LDA, QDA, KNN, Bootstrap, Subset selection, Ridge regression, LASSO, Tree-based methods, Support vector machines, Clustering, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), robust design, maintainability, reliability, quality control, assurance sciences, predictive modeling, statistical models, engineering applications, implementing existing techniques, developing new techniques, real-world problems, review study, emerging area of statistical learning, data mining, measurement principles, data collection, quality engineering problems, statistical learning, Linear regression, Classification, logistic regression, Cross validation, probability, statistics, data analysis
Tools: Python, Canvas
